issue.title: [A+] Audit @react-navigation direct dependencies (remove or document)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Architecture**. App code must not import `@react-navigation/*` directly (Expo Router only), but packages may still sit in `package.json` as a footgun.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Policy in `expo-first-dependencies.mdc`; deps may still be present for transitive/Expo reasons.

**Expected:** Audit complete: unused direct deps removed **or** documented why they must remain (with owners). No drive-by unrelated upgrades.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Audit `package.json` / lockfile for direct `@react-navigation/*`
- Remove only if unused after Expo Router graph check; otherwise document
- `npm run doctor` / `npx expo install --check` if deps change

**Out of scope**
- ESLint import bans (A1)
- Broad dependency bumps

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Written audit result in PR body (keep vs remove per package)
- [ ] Removals leave app building (`typecheck`, doctor clean)
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm run typecheck`
2. `npm run doctor`
3. `npx expo install --check`
4. `npm test -- --ci`

## Links

- Sibling: A1
- Docs: `docs/guides/expo-first-dependencies.md`
